title: SRE Concepts: SLIs, SLOs, Error Budgets & The Four Golden Signals — D5
purpose: Shows what changes at 10x load and where operational cost moves.
routing_rationale: Error budgets turn reliability from an adversarial debate between Product and SRE into an objective, data-driven mathematical policy: feature velocity continues only while error budget remains.

nodes.label: Availability SLI Probe
nodes.detail: Good requests (non-5xx) / Total requests measured at Load Balancer: 99.94% over 30d.

nodes.label: Latency SLI Probe
nodes.detail: Percentage of requests completing under 350ms: 98.7% over 30d rolling window.

nodes.label: Error Budget Tracker
nodes.detail: For 99.9% SLO, allows 43 minutes of downtime per month. 35 minutes already consumed.

nodes.label: Cloud Deploy Policy Gate
nodes.detail: Queries error budget before production release; halts non-urgent deployments if budget < 0.

nodes.label: Reliability Sprint Mode
nodes.detail: Mandates that 100% of engineering bandwidth switches to bug fixes and resilience hardening.

steps.title: SLI Telemetry Aggregation
steps.action: Cloud Monitoring MQL evaluates availability and latency ratios over 30-day rolling window.
steps.why_traversal: Provides objective mathematical quantification of user happiness.

steps.title: Budget Evaluation & Release Gating
steps.action: If error budget drops to 0%, deployment pipeline automatically locks out feature releases.
steps.why_traversal: Aligns developer incentives directly with system reliability.

scenarios.label: Executive Override Deploys Fragile Feature
scenarios.root_cause: Executive manually overrode deployment freeze while error budget was exhausted at 0%.
scenarios.diverted_path: Unstable feature release causes 5-hour global outage.
scenarios.blast_radius: System availability drops to 98.2%; SLA financial penalty triggered.
scenarios.recovery: Establish strict C-level governance requiring joint VP Engineering and SRE sign-off to override freeze.

scenarios.label: Quota exhausted
scenarios.root_cause: A project or regional quota reaches its allocation limit.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

scenarios.label: Dependency unavailable
scenarios.root_cause: A required API or downstream dependency is unavailable.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

summary: Shows what changes at 10x load and where operational cost moves.
